#!/usr/bin/env bash

# sysbench Lua 脚本目录（Ubuntu 通常为 /usr/share/sysbench/）
script_path="/usr/share/sysbench/"

if [ "${1}" == "read" ]
then
    run_script=${script_path}"oltp_read_only.lua"
elif [ "${1}" == "write" ]
then
    run_script=${script_path}"oltp_write_only.lua"
else
    run_script=${script_path}"oltp_read_write.lua"  
fi

MODE="$1"; HOST="$2"; PORT="$3"; PASS="$4"
# 兼容两种调用方式：
# 1) 6 参：run_sysbench.sh <mode> <host> <port> <pass> <duration_s> <outfile>
# 2) 5 参：run_sysbench.sh <mode> <host> <port> <pass> <outfile>   (duration 使用默认 60s)
#
# 你在 DB-BERT 中希望使用：
#   SYSBENCH_CMD="bash $(pwd)/scripts/run_sysbench.sh read 127.0.0.1 3306 <REDACTED_PASSWORD> /tmp/sb.log"
# 因此这里专门支持 5 参模式。
if [ "$#" -ge 6 ]; then
    DURATION="${5:-60}"
    OUTFILE="$6"
else
    DURATION="${SYSBENCH_TIME:-60}"
    OUTFILE="$5"
fi
TEE="${SYSBENCH_TEE:-0}"

# 根据端口判断 MySQL 或 PostgreSQL 参数
if [ "${PORT}" = "5432" ]; then
    DRIVER="pgsql"
    HOST_OPT="--pgsql-host=${HOST}"
    PORT_OPT="--pgsql-port=${PORT}"
    PGUSER="${PGUSER:-postgres}"
    USER_OPT="--pgsql-user=${PGUSER}"
    PASS_OPT="--pgsql-password=${PASS}"
    DB_OPT="--pgsql-db=sbtest"
    EXTRA_OPTS=""
else
    DRIVER="mysql"
    HOST_OPT="--mysql-host=${HOST}"
    PORT_OPT="--mysql-port=${PORT}"
    USER_OPT="--mysql-user=root"
    PASS_OPT="--mysql-password=${PASS}"
    DB_OPT="--mysql-db=sbtest"
    EXTRA_OPTS="--mysql-storage-engine=innodb"
fi

THREADS=$( [ "${MODE}" = "read" ] && echo 64 || echo 32 )

# PG: ensure database/tables prepared once
if [ "${DRIVER}" = "pgsql" ]; then
    export PGPASSWORD="${PASS}"
    # ensure db exists
    if ! psql -h "${HOST}" -p "${PORT}" -U "${PGUSER}" -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='sbtest'" | grep -q 1; then
        psql -h "${HOST}" -p "${PORT}" -U "${PGUSER}" -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -c "CREATE DATABASE sbtest;" || true
    fi
    # check table count
    tbl_cnt=$(psql -h "${HOST}" -p "${PORT}" -U "${PGUSER}" -d sbtest -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name LIKE 'sbtest%';" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ -z "${tbl_cnt}" ]; then tbl_cnt=0; fi
    if [ "${tbl_cnt}" -ne 32 ]; then
        # drop and recreate to avoid partial prepare conflicts
        psql -h "${HOST}" -p "${PORT}" -U "${PGUSER}" -d postgres -q -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='sbtest';" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        psql -h "${HOST}" -p "${PORT}" -U "${PGUSER}" -d postgres -q -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS sbtest;" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        psql -h "${HOST}" -p "${PORT}" -U "${PGUSER}" -d postgres -q -c "CREATE DATABASE sbtest;" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        sysbench ${run_script} \
            ${HOST_OPT} \
            ${PORT_OPT} \
            ${USER_OPT} \
            ${PASS_OPT} \
            ${DB_OPT} \
            --db-driver=${DRIVER} \
            ${EXTRA_OPTS} \
            --tables=32 \
            --table-size=1000000 \
            prepare >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
fi

sysbench ${run_script} \
        ${HOST_OPT} \
        ${PORT_OPT} \
        ${USER_OPT} \
        ${PASS_OPT} \
        ${DB_OPT} \
        --db-driver=${DRIVER} \
        ${EXTRA_OPTS} \
        --range-size=100 \
        --events=0 \
        --rand-type=uniform \
        --tables=32 \
        --table-size=1000000 \
        --report-interval=5 \
        --threads=${THREADS} \
        --time=${DURATION} \
